mapper.select: SELECT * FROM train_schedule_watermark WHERE train_id = #{trainId} ORDER BY depart_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT * FROM train_schedule_watermark WHERE train_id = #{trainId} AND ( (#{startTime} BETWEEN depart_time AND arrive_time) OR (#{endTime} BETWEEN depart_time AND arrive_time) OR (depart_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) OR (arrive_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO train_schedule_watermark (train_id, route_id, depart_time, arrive_time, updated_by) VALUES (#{trainId}, #{routeId}, #{departTime}, #{arriveTime}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE route_id = VALUES(route_id), depart_time = VALUES(depart_time), arrive_time = VALUES(arrive_time), updated_by = VALUES(updatedBy)
